name: Positive! Hapili Link
detailed_description:
I’m Kanna Omori. A 16-year-old high school student.

One day, I met Moron, a fairy from the Posiri Kingdom of another world — and somehow, I ended up becoming a super heroine.

He said he wants me to help protect his homeland from the evil clutches of the Negari Republic.

What even is this? It’s way too scary.

“Positive! Hapili Link” is a side-scrolling adventure action game set in a small town somewhere in Japan.

The player takes on the role of Kanna Omori, a 16-year-old high school girl, who teams up with Moron, the fairy from another world, to fight against agents of the Negari Republic, also from another world.

The game is divided into two parts: the Adventure Part, where you search for the "Nega Vacuum" devices that the enemy agents have hidden around town, and the Battle Part, where you transform into the super heroine "Hapili Link" to destroy the discovered Nega Vacuums.

In the Adventure Part, you explore the town alongside Moron, gathering clues and uncovering the Nega Vacuums disguised as everyday objects.

In the Battle Part, you borrow the fairy’s power to transform into the super heroine "Hapili Link" and use her minigun to fight and destroy the Nega Vacuums.

The game focuses on immersion in the story, so both the Adventure and Battle parts feature a relatively gentle difficulty level.

Enjoy a story full of laughter, tears, and heartwarming moments.

The superpowered transformation phrase is: “Positive! Hapili Link!”
